JwtBearer._comment_deployed: RequireHttpsMetadata ships true so deployed environments are HTTPS-only by default; appsettings.Development.json and appsettings.Testing.json relax it for the local http Keycloak. Deployed environments must still point Authentication__JwtBearer__Authority at an https:// OIDC endpoint — the host refuses to start otherwise. Internal-plaintext-metadata topologies are unsupported by design; see ADR-0009 'Taking this to production'.

ServiceAuth._comment_secret: Local-dev only. Production overrides via a secret store per ADR-0010.
ServiceAuth._comment_deployed: The http:// Authority is local-dev only. Deployed environments MUST set ServiceAuth__Authority to an https:// OIDC realm URL — the outbound AddServiceAuth guard fails the host boot otherwise, because the client_secret and RFC 8693 exchanged tokens POST to the token endpoint derived from it. Internal-plaintext-metadata topologies are unsupported by design; see ADR-0009 item 10.
